channels.channel: sports shops and sports nutrition shops

companies.name: Balmelli Sport (Società Anonima Giovanni Balmelli "Faspea")
channel_category: sports shops and sports nutrition shops
companies.distributes: Sports nutrition shelf with energy bars and gels brands Enervit, Named, Sponser and Winforce, for use before, during and after sport
companies.channels_supplied: Its own shops in central Lugano: Balmelli Sport, Balmellino (children) and Outlet Sport by Balmelli, plus an online shop
companies.fit_rationale: Lugano's long-established independent sports shop, with a sports nutrition shelf of other brands and staff who advise athletes on what to take. Tier 3 because it is a single family business and its website names the nutrition brands but not the individual products.
what_they_do_well: Family business since 1918, in its Palazzo delle Dogane location since 1962, now run by the third generation.

companies.name: Fleurop-Interflora (Schweiz) AG
companies.distributes: Gift chocolate such as Munz chocolate bars and chocolate ladybirds from Maestrani and Milka bars, plus chocolate and sweets gift sets sold with flowers
companies.channels_supplied: Online gift and flower delivery through partner florists, with 90 minute express delivery in over 1,000 Swiss localities and a B2B gift service
companies.fit_rationale: Switzerland's flower and gift delivery network already sells other brands' chocolate as gifts (Maestrani Munz, Milka) and has a Schokolade and Sweets gift set range, a good home for Diablo's chocolate boxes and gift packs. It delivers gifts across Switzerland, Lugano included, and runs a business gifts channel.
what_they_do_well: Offers express delivery within 90 minutes in over 1,000 Swiss localities.
Business orders placed by 15:00 are delivered the same day across Switzerland.
